scope: Segment 108 field-level rules, serialization, applicability, and companion-segment scope for the dedicated Loyalty Card Transaction Request

rules.title: Segment 108 belongs exclusively to the Loyalty Card Transaction Request; it is not a Financial Transaction Request companion
rules.note: REOPENED 2026-09-29 (SEG108-SME-008): the Chapter 12 segment/transaction matrix marks Segment 108 in the Financial Transaction Request and EMV Financial Transaction Request columns, Section 10.9.2 says Purchase/Capture, Purchase Reversal and TOR can include loyalty card information, and Element 63's Financial Transaction Request processing rule defers Data Section 3 content to Chapter 12. Only the Section 11.1.1 layout table omits Segment 108. Held at REVIEW_REQUIRED and not code-enforced until an SME confirms with a citation.

rules.title: Segment 108 is required in every Loyalty Card Transaction Request
Segment Type is 108
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
Segment 108 maximum length is 142 alphanumeric characters
rules.note: SME-confirmed 2026-09-22: 142 is authoritative (Section 12.7 opening + Element 84 valid-values table both state 142); the Loyalty Card Transaction Request layout table's '84' figure is a spec typo (SEG108-SME-001, RESOLVED).

rules.title: Field order matches Section 12.7 (Segment Type, Segment Length, Loyalty Program ID, Loyalty Account Number, Points to Redeem, Coupon ID, Coupon Amount, Update Code, Street Address, Phone Number Loyalty, Expiration Date, Payment Tender Type, Loyalty Track 2 Data, Loyalty Information Version, Unit of Work)
rules.note: Fields 12-13 are element 148 then element 147, i.e. positional field order does not match ascending element-number order.

rules.title: All fields are separated by Field Separators, including a separator following the last field; empty fields still send the separator
Loyalty Program ID, required, is numeric with maximum length 6
Loyalty Account Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 24
Points to Redeem, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 6
Coupon ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 19
Coupon Amount, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 8
Update Code, when populated, is exactly one alphanumeric character from the documented set A, C, E, I, P, S, T, U
Street Address, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 5
Phone Number, Loyalty, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Expiration Date, when populated, is numeric length 4 in MMYY format; device sends default 1249 when no expiration date is present on the card
rules.note: SME-resolved 2026-09-22 (SEG108-SME-007): Section 12.7's field table note ('reserved for future use') is superseded by Section 13.2's full element definition and Section 10.9.1.2's documented manual-entry default-value behavior (1249 MMYY); treated as a real, format-validated field, not inert.

rules.title: Payment Tender Type is required, exactly 2 alphanumeric characters from the documented set AX, CK, CS, DB, DN, DS, EB, EC, FL, GC, JC, MC, PC, PR, VS
Loyalty Track 2 Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 38
Loyalty Information Version, when populated, is numeric length 1 with valid values 1 or 2; defaults to 1 when not sent
Unit of Work, when populated, is numeric with fixed length 19; required on loyalty reversals to match the original purchase
Segment 108 appears exactly once per message
Segment 108 originates at the device
Segment 108's sole optional Data Section 3 companion is Segment 114 (SKU Data Segment)
Segment 108 does not appear in the Loyalty Card Transaction Response, which mirrors the generic Financial Transaction Response layout
In a Loyalty Card Transaction Request, Element 63 (Number of Segments) counts Segment 100, Segment 108 and the optional Segment 114, so it is 2 or 3 and equals the number of segments present
rules.note: The upper bound of 3 follows the Section 11.2.1 layout, which has a single Field No. 5 slot for Segment 114. If SEG114 P-06 (repeatable Segment 114) is confirmed with a citation, raise the bound.

provisionalItems.question: Section 12.7 and the Element 84 rule both state max length 142, but the Loyalty Card Transaction Request layout table states 84 for Segment 108. Which governs?
provisionalItems.resolution: User confirmed 2026-09-22: 142 is authoritative; 84 is a spec table typo.

provisionalItems.question: Section 10.9.3 describes 9-10 distinct loyalty advice functions (including 'Reversal of coupon redeem' and 'Reversal of points redeemed') but Element 143 only documents 8 Update Code values (A,C,E,I,P,S,T,U). Which code(s) represent the two reversal functions?

User indicated Segment 108 (or loyalty data) DOES appear in some response scenario(s), contradicting the literal Section 11.2.2 text, but could not yet specify which scenario(s) or field layout. Needs a follow-up answer with a section/page reference before SEG108-R-024 can be enforced with confidence.

blocks: separate-domain, not this segment's Item 1-8 scope

provisionalItems.resolution: User confirmed 2026-09-22: catalog only; not code-enforced (consistent with other segments' business-condition rules).

provisionalItems.resolution: User confirmed 2026-09-22: Expiration Date is a real, format-validated field (MMYY, default 1249); Section 12.7's note is outdated/incomplete.

Is 142 a cap on the populated segment (so not every field can be at its maximum at once), or is the documented maximum stale after Fields 14-15 were added?
